message.content:
**Short answer:**  
In 2026 the football community largely regards **Erling Haaland** as “the best” active player – he’s been the league‑top scorer in both Serie A (with Inter Milan) and Premier League (after moving back to Man City), has broken multiple goal‑scoring records, and led Norway to its first major tournament semi‑finals since 1998.

---

### Why Haaland stands out right now  

| Category | Current status |
|----------|----------------|
| **Club form** | 34 goals in 32 matches across all competitions last season (Premier League + Champions League). |
| **International impact** | Scored 12 goals in Euro 2024 qualifiers, helping Norway reach their first European Championship knockout stage in decades. |
| **Awards & recognition** | Winner of the 2025 PFA Players’ Player of the Year, UEFA Best Forward Award, and named FIFPro World XI captain. |
| **Physical attributes** | 7 ft tall striker combining pace, strength, and clinical finishing—rare combination at elite level. |

> *“He doesn’t just score; he changes how teams play around him.”* — former England manager Gareth Southgate

---

### Other close contenders  

| Player | Club | Key achievements (last two seasons) |
|--------|------|-------------------------------------|
| **Kylian Mbappé** | PSG | Won Ligue 1 Golden Boot twice, scored 30+ goals in each campaign, helped France win Nations Cup 2025. |
| **Lionel Messi** *(retired from club)* | Retired (but occasionally plays for Argentina) | Still nets crucial goals in internationals, holds record for most career assists in La Liga. |
| **Kevin De Bruyne** | Manchester United | Led midfield creativity, 10+ assists per season, key role in UCL quarter‑final run. |

While those players remain influential, none match Haaland’s sheer goal output combined with consistent high‑level performances across domestic leagues and Europe.

---

#### Bottom line  
If you’re looking for the single player who dominates headlines, statistics, and fan sentiment today, it’s **Erling Haaland**. If you prefer a more holistic assessment—including leadership, versatility, and longevity—the debate remains open between him, Mbappé, and even seasoned veterans like Messi when they appear on the pitch.
